summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements, MD&A, and a press release for Q2 and H1 2026. The filing discloses revenue of $16.3 million (H1), down from $25.2 million year-over-year, net loss of $6.9 million ($0.85 per share), and cash of $1.6 million. This is a routine periodic earnings report under Rule 13a-16, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or strategic review. The registrant simply reports operational results and financial condition. No deal terms or board actions are present. The filing is solely informational, providing financial performance updates to investors, and does not propose any transactional or structural change.
